deviation: The draft limits confidentiality survival to 1 year after the Agreement ends, below the 3-year standard and the 2-year fallback minimum. It also has no indefinite protection for trade secrets, so sensitive information could be freely used or disclosed after only a year.
suggested_text: 8.3 The obligations in this Section 8 shall survive for three (3) years after this Agreement ends; provided that, with respect to any Confidential Information that constitutes a trade secret, such obligations shall continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret.
